interests.interestText: 18-22 August 2021: I visited Copenhagen to contribute a Northern Ireland perspective on LGBT+ issues. Flights (�130) and four nights accommodation was paid for by the Party of European Socialists (PES) (Rainbow Rose). (Registered 10 June 2022) 30 September-5 October 2024: I was in Washington DC as a fellow of the Vital Voices Engage Programme for in-person professional development training. Vital Voices Global Partnership is a non-profit organisation based in Washington DC which supports leadership development of women across the world. The total cost of the trip, including travel, accommodation and meals, was covered by Vital Voices and was approximately US$2,072. (Registered 29 August 2024) � 2-8 December 2024: I visited Oxford, England to participate in the InfoLead Institute Policy Making training programme at the University of Oxford. The cost of return flights, six nights accommodation and the tuition fee (totalling �2,113.16) was met by the University of Oxford. (Registered 5 November 2024) � 15-16 May 2025: I visited Florence University, Italy for a follow-up discussion from December 2024 on the Oxford University InfoLead Programme on digital interference with democracy and policymaking. The cost of the flights and accommodation, totalling �656.86 was met by Oxford University. (Registered 10 June 2025) � 25-26 May 2025: I visited Berlin, Germany to speak at a conference and contribute on a panel on the need for enhanced support for victims of AI harms. The cost of the travel, accommodation, and guest speaker payment (totalling �834.21) was met by Mission KI. (Registered 17 June 2025) �

interests.interestText: None. (Registered 10 April 2017) 14 - 20 October 2018: I visited Washington DC and New York to talk about my experience as a student of the Washington Ireland Program in 2010 and 2012. Flight costs, accommodation for one night and a train journey was paid by the Washington Ireland Program, an organisation based in Ireland and the United States of America. The total cost covered by the Washington Ireland Program was 1,219-92 USD or 948- 60 GBP. (Registered 25 October 2018) 28 November 2018 - 1 December 2018: I attended the 'Twenty Years of Peace' conference in Connecticut, United States of America, which was organised by Yale University. The cost of flights, transfers, accommodation and meals was covered by Yale University. (Registered 12 December 2018) 27 February 2020: I delivered a guest lecture on 'The Role of Progressives in Northern Ireland Unionism' at Birkbeck College, University of London. The College reimbursed my travel and accommodation costs totalling �333.47 on 24 April 2020. (Registered 29 April 2020)

Market value of the hotel room for two nights was �515 Euros. A friend accompanied me on the trip and received a free ticket to the event which has a market value of �10. (Registered 29 July 2022) 12 September 2022: I received �294.44 from the Galway International Arts Festival, which covered the costs of travel incurred in attending the "First Thought Talks - Middle Ground in Northern Ireland?" event held on 16 July 2022. (Registered 16 September 2022)
